description: Central Bank - Order under Monetary  Law  Act; Reserve Requirements that published in the Gazette Extraordinary No. 1805/39 to 12.04.2013 to be further amend
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made by the Monetary Board of Sri Lanka under the Monetary Law Act, specifically amending reserve requirements for banks. It involves legal/regulatory matters including statutory instruments, compliance requirements, and amendments to existing financial regulations, fitting the definition of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5).
